New Moon.title: THE DARK MYSTERY
New Moon.poem: In the void between breaths, all potential dwells. The seed waits in darkness, gathering courage to split its shell. Plant intentions now—they will grow with the light.

Waxing Crescent.title: THE FIRST BREATH
Waxing Crescent.poem: A sliver of silver pierces the night. The dream begins to breathe, taking its first steps into form. Trust the unfolding.

First Quarter.title: THE CROSSROADS
First Quarter.poem: Half light, half shadow—decision hangs in the balance. The path forward requires action. Choose, and the universe conspires.

Waxing Gibbous.title: THE GATHERING
Waxing Gibbous.poem: Almost full, almost complete. The momentum builds like a wave cresting. Refine, adjust, prepare for the revelation.

Full Moon.title: THE GREAT REVEALING
Full Moon.poem: All that was hidden in darkness is now revealed in light. The seed planted at the New Moon breaks through soil. Your work culminates. The world witnesses your fullness.

Waning Gibbous.title: THE SHARING
Waning Gibbous.poem: The light begins its gentle retreat, but wisdom remains. Share what you have learned. Teach others what the fullness taught you.

Last Quarter.title: THE RELEASING
Last Quarter.poem: Half remains, half must go. What will you carry forward? What will you leave behind? The choice is yours, and yours alone.

Waning Crescent.title: THE SURRENDER
Waning Crescent.poem: A silver whisper fading into black. Rest now. The work is done. Surrender to the darkness, knowing light will return.

template.name: Template Library
template.description: 169+ hand-crafted planet-sign templates, woven into unique readings by moon phase, aspect, and life category. Always free, always instant, no setup required.
template.pricingNote: No costs ever. Powered by our curated template system.

setupSteps.title: Select Template Library
setupSteps.description: This is the default option. No configuration needed.
setupSteps.tip: Templates cover all major celestial events and planetary positions

setupSteps.title: Start Using Immediately
setupSteps.description: All astrological readings will use our pre-written template library.
setupSteps.tip: You can switch to AI providers anytime in the future

groq.name: Groq
groq.description: Lightning-fast AI inference with Llama 3. Free tier includes 1M tokens daily.
groq.keyFormat: Starts with "gsk_" followed by alphanumeric characters
groq.pricingNote: Free tier: 1M tokens/day. Paid plans available for higher usage.

setupSteps.title: Create a Groq Account
setupSteps.description: Visit the Groq Console and sign up for a free account.
setupSteps.tip: Use your email or Google account for quick signup

setupSteps.title: Navigate to API Keys
setupSteps.description: Once logged in, click "API Keys" in the left sidebar.
setupSteps.tip: Look for the key icon in the navigation menu

setupSteps.title: Create New API Key
setupSteps.description: Click the "Create API Key" button. Give it a name like "HEKA Calendar".
setupSteps.tip: Choose a descriptive name so you remember what it's for

setupSteps.title: Copy Your API Key
setupSteps.description: Copy the generated key (starts with "gsk_"). Store it securely - you won't see it again.
setupSteps.tip: ⚠️ For security, Groq only shows the full key once. If you lose it, create a new one.

setupSteps.title: Paste Key in HEKA
setupSteps.description: Return to this screen and paste your key below. Click "Test Connection" to verify.
setupSteps.tip: Your key is stored only on this device

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.description: GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 Turbo for nuanced astrological interpretations. Industry-leading quality.
openai.freeTierInfo: $5 in free credits for new users
openai.keyFormat: Starts with "sk-" followed by alphanumeric characters
openai.pricingNote: Pay-per-use after free credits. GPT-3.5: ~$0.002 per 1K tokens.

setupSteps.title: Create OpenAI Account
setupSteps.description: Sign up at OpenAI Platform. You'll need email verification and a phone number.
setupSteps.tip: Have your phone ready for SMS verification

setupSteps.title: Add Payment Method (Optional)
setupSteps.description: While you get $5 in free credits, adding a payment method ensures uninterrupted service.
setupSteps.tip: You can set usage limits to control costs in Billing Settings

setupSteps.title: Go to API Keys Section
setupSteps.description: Click your profile picture → "Your Profile" → "User API Keys" or visit the direct link.
setupSteps.tip: Don't confuse this with "Project API Keys" - we need User API Keys

setupSteps.title: Create New Secret Key
setupSteps.description: Click "Create new secret key". Name it "HEKA Calendar" for easy identification.
setupSteps.tip: ⚠️ OpenAI only shows the full key once. Copy it immediately!

setupSteps.title: Configure in HEKA
setupSteps.description: Paste your key below and test the connection. Monitor usage in OpenAI dashboard.
setupSteps.tip: Set up billing alerts at platform.openai.com/settings/organization/billing/limits

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.description: Claude AI for thoughtful, nuanced astrological guidance with extended context.
anthropic.freeTierInfo: $5 in free credits for new users
anthropic.keyFormat: Starts with "sk-ant-" followed by alphanumeric characters
anthropic.pricingNote: Competitive rates. Claude 3 Haiku: ~$0.25 per 1K tokens.

setupSteps.title: Sign Up for Anthropic
setupSteps.description: Create an account at Anthropic Console using your work email.
setupSteps.tip: Anthropic may have a waitlist - approval is usually quick

setupSteps.title: Verify Your Account
setupSteps.description: Check your email for verification link. Complete any required verification steps.
setupSteps.tip: Check spam folder if you don't see the email within a few minutes

setupSteps.title: Access API Keys
setupSteps.description: In the console, go to Settings → API Keys or use the direct link below.
setupSteps.tip: The settings gear icon is in the top-right corner

setupSteps.title: Generate API Key
setupSteps.description: Click "Create Key". Give it a descriptive name like "HEKA Astrology".
setupSteps.tip: You can create multiple keys for different apps

setupSteps.title: Copy and Configure
setupSteps.description: Copy the key (starts with "sk-ant-") and paste it below in HEKA.
setupSteps.tip: Keys never expire unless you revoke them manually

ollama.name: Ollama (Local)
ollama.description: Run AI models entirely on your own device. Complete privacy, no internet needed after setup.
ollama.pricingNote: No costs. Requires capable hardware (8GB+ RAM recommended).

setupSteps.title: Download Ollama
setupSteps.description: Download and install Ollama for your operating system (Mac, Linux, or Windows).
setupSteps.tip: Windows version is available via Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL2)

setupSteps.title: Install a Model
setupSteps.description: Open terminal and run: ollama pull llama3 or ollama pull mistral
setupSteps.tip: Llama 3 is recommended for best results. Models are several GB to download.

setupSteps.title: Start Ollama Server
setupSteps.description: Run: ollama serve to start the local API server. Keep this terminal open.
setupSteps.tip: The server runs on http://localhost:11434 by default

setupSteps.title: Verify Installation
setupSteps.description: Test by running: ollama run llama3 in another terminal. Type a test message.
setupSteps.tip: First run downloads the model. Subsequent runs are instant.

setupSteps.title: Connect HEKA
setupSteps.description: Enter the server URL (usually http://localhost:11434) below and test connection.
setupSteps.tip: Ollama must be running whenever you want AI-enhanced readings
